name: GRIEVANCE
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO SOUND THE FORK FOR HER (errata 267): to the right of her half door, turned to her. From in front of the door he hid her head, and she walked out of her stall through his back.
note: GRIEVANCE, a mule 'the color of a wet saddle' (doc 54), looking out over her half door. Five whole-mule poses on magenta, generated against a side-by-side with Thad (room-15 operation 4), cut at the door's top by tools/art/room15-figures.py, so `y` is the cut row, not her hooves. Her examine lines and the fork (B3) are the GRIEVANCE hotspot's. Doc 54's 'Her ears follow me round the stable' is frames 2 and 3.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest · 1 breath (derived) · 2 ears round to the left · 3 her head turned to look left · 4 a snort. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77). · ACTED ONLY: 5 nothing, while she is out of her stall in `grievance_out` (doc 54 B3, doc 95 row 79; errata 197).
